notes: Unique respondent identifier; maps to person_id as the primary key for the person table.
Data release cycle indicator. Stored as an observation with a custom concept for survey metadata.
Interview/examination status. Stored as an observation; no standard OMOP concept for NHANES participation status.
Gender of participant. 1=Male maps to 8507, 2=Female maps to 8532.
Age in years at screening. Used to calculate year_of_birth (approximate) based on survey year.
Age in months for children ≤24 months. Stored as observation; can be used to refine year/month of birth.
Race/Hispanic origin recode. Used to derive both ethnicity_concept_id (Hispanic/Non-Hispanic) and race_concept_id. Mapping requires combining with RIDRETH3 for Asian detail.
Detailed race/Hispanic origin with Non-Hispanic Asian. Primary source for race_concept_id (e.g., 8527=White, 8516=Black, 8515=Asian).
Six-month exam period. Stored as observation; may relate to seasonality in measurements.
Age in years at exam for 2-19 years. Stored as observation; complements RIDAGEYR for precise age at measurement.
Age in months at exam for ≤19 years. Stored as observation; provides granular age for pediatric measurements.
Served in US Armed Forces. Maps to OMOP concept 4052025 (Military service) as observation.
Served in foreign country during conflict. No standard concept; stored as observation.
Country of birth (US vs. other). Can inform location_id or be stored as observation for birthplace detail.
US citizenship status. No standard OMOP concept; stored as observation.
Length of time in US. Stored as observation; relevant for acculturation/social determinants.
Education level for children/youth 6-19. Stored as observation; no standard OMOP concept for grade level.
Education level for adults 20+. Maps to concept 4076627 (Educational attainment) as observation.
Marital status. Maps to concept 4052023 (Marital status) as observation.
Pregnancy status at exam. Maps to concept 4328749 (Pregnancy status) as observation.
Language of SP interview. Stored as observation; no standard concept for interview language.
Proxy used in SP interview. Stored as observation; indicates data quality/reliability.
Interpreter used in SP interview. Stored as observation.
Language of Family interview. Stored as observation.
Proxy used in Family interview. Stored as observation.
Interpreter used in Family interview. Stored as observation.
Language of MEC interview. Stored as observation.
Proxy used in MEC interview. Stored as observation.
Interpreter used in MEC interview. Stored as observation.
Language of ACASI interview. Stored as observation.
Full sample 2-year interview weight. Stored as observation with value_as_number; essential for survey analysis.
Full sample 2-year MEC exam weight. Stored as observation; used for analyses of examined participants.
Masked variance pseudo-PSU. Design variable for variance estimation; not mapped to CDM but used in statistical analysis.
Masked variance pseudo-stratum. Design variable; not mapped to CDM.
Annual household income. Maps to concept 4076626 (Household income) as observation.
Annual family income. Maps to concept 4076626 (Household income) as observation; family-level income.
Ratio of family income to poverty. Stored as observation with value_as_number; key social determinant.
Total number of people in household. Stored as observation.
Total number of people in family. Stored as observation.
Number of children ≤5 years in household. Stored as observation.
Number of children 6-17 years in household. Stored as observation.
Number of adults ≥60 years in household. Stored as observation.
Household reference person's gender. Stored as observation; not the participant's gender.
Household reference person's age. Stored as observation.
Household reference person's country of birth. Stored as observation.
Household reference person's education level. Maps to concept 4076627 (Educational attainment) as observation.
Household reference person's marital status. Maps to concept 4052023 (Marital status) as observation.
Household reference person's spouse's education level. Maps to concept 4076627 (Educational attainment) as observation.
